purpose: Pre-registered contiguous PR-number windows and observation week for v8 queue timeline evidence (GraphQL merge-queue events), independent of merge_group workflow-run success.

pr_universe.enumeration_policy: Every integer pull request number in each closed interval is queried via GraphQL whether or not a merge_group Actions run exists or succeeded.

episode_rules.left_censoring: Added without matching Removed before observation_week end or dataset freeze
episode_rules.right_censoring: Removed without prior Added in paginated timeline (data gap flag)

head_sha_policy.at_fetch_field: headRefOid from GraphQL at collection time
head_sha_policy.not_enqueue_time: AddedToMergeQueueEvent does not expose per-episode head OID in public GraphQL (see api_gaps.json)
head_sha_policy.alignment_with_merge_group: Optional crosswalk to merge_group head_sha and queue branch parent_sha when workflow runs exist in observation week

attribution_guardrails: Do not label integration_regression when merge_group head_sha and PR headRefOid at fetch are not comparable for the same episode window
Retries counted as comparable only when headRefOid at fetch matches across episodes or merge_group head repeats for same pr_number
provenance_requirements: Freeze this spec before any API calls
Log GraphQL page cursors and timeline page counts per PR
